Background/Base.description: Applicable for : Frames & Shapes only .....Default page, modal, and menu background.

Background/Brand.description: Use for the background of elements used to reinforce our brand, that need to stand out a lot, like primary actions or spotlight cards, or to show progress

Background/Failure.description: Use for backgrounds communicating critical information, such in error banner messages.

Background/Ghost Highlight.description: Use for backgrounds of selected state for transparent clickable UI elements.

Background/Ghost Hover.description: Use for backgrounds of hover state for transparent clickable UI elements.

Background/Information.description: Use for backgrounds communicating information or something in-progress, such as in information banner messages.

Background/Inverse.description: Applicable for : Frames & Shapes only.....Use for backgrounds Overlay background for modals.

Background/On Base.description: Applicable for : Frames & Shapes only....Use for objects that sit on Base. Example - Navigation bars, chat bubbles, etc.

Background/Overlay.description: Use for the screen overlay that appears with modal dialogs.

Background/Raised.description: Use for objects that appear elevated over other UI elements, like menus and prompt bars. They must be paired with appropriate shadows.

Background/Secondary Action.description: Use for backgrounds of secondary clickable actions.

Background/Success.description: Use for backgrounds communicating success or a favourable outcome, such as success banner messages

Background/Sunken.description: Applicable for : Frames & Shapes only.....Use for backgrounds that sit behind base, example search data or liveboard.

Background/Warning.description: Use for backgrounds communicating caution, such as warning banner messages

Border/Accent/Blue.description: Use for blue borders on accent backgrounds when there is no meaning tied to the color

Border/Accent/Gray.description: Use for gray borders on accent backgrounds when there is no meaning tied to the color

Border/Accent/Green.description: Use for green borders on accent backgrounds when there is no meaning tied to the color

Border/Accent/Purple.description: Use for purple borders on accent backgrounds when there is no meaning tied to the color

Border/Accent/Red.description: Use for red borders on accent backgrounds when there is no meaning tied to the color

Border/Accent/Yellow.description: Use for yellow borders on accent backgrounds when there is no meaning tied to the color

Border/Bold.description: Use for borders of selectable UI elements like input boxes, search bars, checkboxes, and radio buttons

Border/Bold Hover.description: Use for hover borders of selectable UI elements like input boxes, search bars, checkboxes, and radio buttons

Border/Brand.description: Use for borders or visual indicators of elements that reinforce our brand, such as selected states of form fields and cards

Border/Failure.description: Use for borders communicating critical information, such as the borders on invalid text fields, which blocks a workflow

Border/Focus.description: Use for focus rings of elements in a focus state.

Border/Gap.description: Use for borders that need to appear invisible.

Border/Subtle.description: Use to visually group or separate unselectable UI elements, such as flat cards or dividers

Border/Subtle Hover.description: Use for hover state for cards which are not selectable but can still be interacted with.

Content/Brand.description: Use for text and icon that reinforce our brand

Content/Failure.description: Use for critical text and icon, which blocks a workflow

Content/Information.description: Use for informative text and icon or to communicate something is in progress.

Content/Inverse.description: Text stays white in both modes....Use for text and icons on inverse backgrounds

Content/Primary.description: Use for primary text like body copy, headers, and buttons, and icons paired with primary text or buttons

Content/Secondary.description: Use for secondary text like footnote, captions, description, and icons paired with secondary text.

Content/Success.description: Use for text and icon to communicate a favourable outcome

Content/Tertiary.description: Use for non clickable icons, like spinner, or illustrations

Content/Warning.description: Use for icons to emphasize caution
